Name: Scale
Description: The scale of the noise. Higher values create larger, less detailed shapes. Lower values create noisier, highly detailed shapes.

Name: Octaves
Description: The number of noise octaves. Higher values create more complexity.

Name: Seed
Description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process.

Name: Octaves
Description: The number of noise octaves. Higher values create more complexity.

Name: Scale X
Description: The non-uniform scale of the X axis.

Name: Scale Y
Description: The non-uniform scale of the Y axis.
